# Machine Translation {#sec-machine-translation}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- explain why translation is the task that produced the attention mechanism;
- pick a decoding strategy suited to translation rather than to chat;
- evaluate a translation system without trusting BLEU on its own;
- decide whether to translate your data, your query, or neither.

## Exercises

1. Compute BLEU by hand for one sentence pair, then change one inflectional suffix in the candidate. Report how much BLEU moved and whether the meaning moved as much.
2. Translate 30 sentences with a dedicated MT model and an LLM. Rank the outputs yourself, then check which metric reproduces your ranking most closely.
